title: Gerente Processos e Padronização
description:
Overview

Descrição da vaga. A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália. Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Responsibilities
  • Responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento, implementação e monitoramento dos processos produtivos no curtume, assegurando que as operações sejam realizadas com eficiência, qualidade e dentro dos padrões estabelecidos. Este profissional atuará como elo entre as diversas áreas da empresa, promovendo melhorias contínuas e garantindo a conformidade normativa.
  • Desenvolver procedimentos operacionais padrão (POP) para todas as etapas do processo produtivo. Assegurar que todos os colaboradores estejam devidamente treinados nas normas estabelecidas, promovendo uniformidade na execução das tarefas.
  • Implementar sistemas robustos de controle da qualidade em todas as fases da produção. Monitorar indicadores-chave (KPIs) relacionados à qualidade e eficiência operacional, realizando análises periódicas para garantir que as metas sejam atingidas.
  • Conduzir projetos focados em melhoria contínua usando metodologias como Lean Manufacturing ou Six Sigma. Facilitar workshops e treinamentos sobre cultura organizacional voltada à melhoria contínua junto às equipes operacionais.
  • Garantir que os processos estejam em conformidade com regulamentos ambientais, saúde ocupacional e normas técnicas específicas do setor coureiro. Manter-se atualizado sobre legislações pertinentes ao setor; interagir com órgãos reguladores quando necessário.
  • Avaliar o impacto financeiro das mudanças nos processos; desenvolver propostas orçamentárias relacionadas a melhorias processuais. Buscar soluções inovadoras que possam reduzir custos sem comprometer a qualidade final do produto.
Qualifications
  • Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, ou engenharias afins.
  • Especialização ou Pós Graduação em Gestão de Projetos.
  • Diferencial - Experiência em melhoria contínua em operações de curtimento de couro.
About Minerva Foods

Bem-vindo à Minerva Foods! A Minerva Foods é líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir "criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza". title: IT Software Engineer - Senior
description:
Overview

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agro-science Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

Basic Function and Scope of Responsibility:

The Software Engineer is primarily responsible for designing, developing, configuring and supporting computer software applications.

  • Work within and assist with management of defined IT processes and procedures including the company’s internal software development life cycle methodology (SDLC)
  • Work with little to no supervision with extreme latitude for independent judgment
  • Consult with senior peers on large complexity projects
  • Proficient in all levels and phases of application development and support
Qualifications

Level I - Minimum

  • 7+ years of successful application & system development and management; database experience utilizing the .NET Framework
  • Proven experience leading tasks or projects related to large size software implementations
  • Experience using and applying System Development Lifecycle Methodologies
  • Proven experience leading tasks or projects related to medium to large size software implementations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business or equivalent experience and training
  • Up to 3 years of successful application & system development and management; database experience utilizing the .NET Framework
  • Analytical, motivated and ability to learn new technologies and applications
  • Ability to multi-task
  • Knowledge and management of System Development Lifecycle Methodologies a plus
  • Goal oriented, with excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with ability to interact effectively and work efficiently with people at all levels in an organization

  • Keenly attentive to detail
  • Ability to keep sensitive information confidential

Preferred Experience:

  • SQL Server or Oracle

  • Leading projects, developing and administrating Specimen Management Systems
  • Leading projects, developing and administrating Lab Instrument Interfaces connecting instruments to LIMS
  • Working knowledge of HL7 standard and coding

  • Corepoint

title: Software Architect (Go)
description:
About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming . We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

About The Role

We are building shared gaming and transactional platforms, with a strong focus on transaction integrity, consistency across services, and long term architectural correctness. The Software Architect will work closely with Tech Leads and senior engineers across both domains, acting as a full time owner of backend architecture, patterns, and guardrails. This role is not about line management, but about ensuring technical coherence, scalability, and correctness across a rapidly evolving distributed system.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and evolve the backend architecture across gaming and transactional platforms, ensuring consistency, correctness, and long term sustainability.
  • Define and enforce architectural patterns, service boundaries, and integration standards, preventing ad hoc solutions and uncontrolled divergence.
  • Design and oversee transaction engines and state management flows, including remediation, compensation, and reconciliation strategies.
  • Drive the adoption of robust distributed system patterns, including saga like workflows, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Act as the primary technical authority for cross service concerns such as consistency models, data ownership, and contract definitions.
  • Partner with Tech Leads on complex design decisions, reviews, and trade offs, providing hands on architectural guidance.
  • Support teams through design reviews and critical pull requests, especially in high risk or high impact areas.
  • Ensure a single source of truth approach across services, leveraging gRPC and strongly typed contracts for cross language integration.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and product teams to ensure architectural decisions align with delivery realities and regulatory constraints.
About You
  • You have 8 plus years of experience in backend engineering, with significant time spent in architect or staff level roles.
  • You are highly proficient in Go and have designed and operated production grade distributed systems using it.
  • You have deep experience with transaction heavy systems, including financial, payments, gaming, or ledger like domains.
  • You have strong practical knowledge of consistency, concurrency, and failure handling in distributed environments.
  • You are comfortable designing and evolving gRPC based APIs and shared contracts across multiple services and languages.
  • You have a strong opinion on clean architecture and system boundaries, but remain pragmatic and delivery focused.
  • You communicate clearly and calmly, and are trusted by teams to unblock complex technical discussions.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with iGaming platforms, payment processing, or regulated financial systems.
  • Hands on experience with saga patterns, compensation flows, and long running process orchestration.
  • Experience working in mixed language environments.
  • Experience defining platform level standards and guiding multiple teams through architectural change.
  • Background in event driven systems or hybrid synchronous asynchronous architectures.
What Success Looks Like
  • Clear, well understood architectural patterns adopted consistently across gaming and transactional platforms.
  • Reduced architectural drift and fewer late stage reworks caused by inconsistent designs.
  • Transaction flows that are observable, recoverable, and auditable by design.
  • Tech Leads and engineers spending less time debating fundamentals and more time delivering value.
  • A platform that can scale in scope and complexity without sacrificing correctness or developer trust.
What kind of culture can I expect?

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world‑class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year. Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a “remote‑first” model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages
  • Application
  • Interview with Recruiter
  • Tech Screening
  • Technical Interview with Data Team
  • Offer
About the Area

In our Data Science team, you'll have the chance to work as a part of our product squads delivering features that enrich our product and a first‑class experience that we are known for. You'll work alongside brilliant minds—Product Managers, Designers, UX Writers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers, etc. Be prepared for the job of your life—hard challenges, high expectations, intelligent life at work, meaningful conversations, outstanding productivity.

Some of the specific problems we work on in the Data Science team include search and recommendation systems; customer experience enhancement using ML such as in automatic routing of tickets; pricing, liquidity and credit models; building a platform that enables us to develop and deploy all those solutions.

Note: This is a senior position. We expect you to have at least 3 + years of experience applying data science and creating machine learning models. If you have the skills, but are starting your journey in Data Science, please apply to the Data Scientist job instead.

Responsibilities
  • Architect, develop and deploy machine learning systems to production. The main use cases are related to chatbots and search.
  • Design and execute experiments.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data (structured and unstructured, observational and experimental) to improve current models or create new ones.
  • Apply the scientific method develop LLM‑powered applications, including testing different prompts, exploring and understanding LLM capabilities, evaluating agents and prompts, assessing AI application guardrails, and building PoCs to validate the feasibility of generative AI for product features.
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions regarding the whole Data Science chapter (Guilds, Design Reviews, Demos, etc.).
What we are looking for
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through Data Science.
  • Expert knowledge of machine learning concepts: regression and classification, clustering, neural networks, feature selection, cross‑validation, curse of dimensionality, bias‑variance tradeoff, model explainability, etc.
  • Good understanding of the engineering challenges to deploy machine learning systems to production.
  • Pro in Python.
  • Some knowledge or experience with Deep Learning.
  • Experience with technical advice for other data scientists (technical leadership).
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills. We're looking for someone who loves Data Science & Machine Learning and is willing to share his/her knowledge with the other members of the Data Science Chapter.
  • Good English skills (verbal and written) is mandatory.
You’ll stand out if you
  • Have a MSc. (or Undergrad + intense experience) in machine learning, data science, information retrieval, ranking systems, recommender systems, natural language processing or other relevant fields.
  • Have experience with applied generative AI: AI agents, prompt engineering, LLMs finetuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), LLM routing, LLM monitoring, LLM guardrails.
  • Have experience working at fast‑growing startups.
Important
  • Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.
  • All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary
  • Profit sharing
  • Meal allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy
  • Wellhub
  • Home office allowance
  • Employee assistance program (mental health, social, legal, and financial support)
  • Extended parental leave
  • Day off on birthday, Mother's Day, and Father's Day
  • Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)
  • Discounts at educational institutions
  • Reading kit for children – PlayKids
Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals! You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non‑affirmative action roles, this data will be used, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas à gestão e manutenção da faixa de domínio da rodovia, garantindo a segurança, a preservação ambiental, o cumprimento das normas legais e o uso adequado da área, com foco em evitar invasões, danos à infraestrutura e impactos negativos para o tráfego e para as operações rodoviárias.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão da Faixa de Domínio: Supervisionar as atividades de monitoramento, controle e manutenção das faixas de domínio das rodovias, garantindo que sejam mantidas dentro dos padrões de segurança, conformidade legal e operacional, respeitando as normas e regulamentações da ANTT, DNIT e outros órgãos reguladores;
  • Prevenção de Invasões e Uso Irregular: Implementar ações para prevenir invasões e o uso irregular da faixa de domínio, como o controle de acesso e a execução de atividades de fiscalização, incluindo a remoção de obstáculos e objetos não autorizados na área;
  • Manutenção de Áreas Verdes e Limpeza: Coordenar a manutenção das áreas verdes e a limpeza da faixa de domínio, incluindo a execução de serviços de jardinagem, roçagem, poda de árvores e controle de vegetação que possa comprometer a segurança viária ou os sistemas de sinalização e comunicação;
  • Acompanhamento de Obras e Projetos: Supervisionar e coordenar projetos de obras de ampliação, manutenção ou adequação da faixa de domínio, como a construção de cercas, muros de contenção, sinalização, sistemas de drenagem, entre outros, assegurando que as atividades sejam realizadas conforme os padrões técnicos e prazos estabelecidos;

  • Segurança e Prevenção de Acidentes: Implementar medidas de segurança para a preservação da faixa de domínio e para proteger os usuários da rodovia, como sinalização adequada, monitoramento de áreas de risco e ações preventivas para evitar acidentes relacionados ao uso irregular da área;
  • Relacionamento com Comunidades e Autoridades: Atuar como ponto de contato com as comunidades locais, órgãos públicos, concessionárias e outras partes interessadas, garantindo o cumprimento das normas, orientando sobre o uso da faixa de domínio e buscando soluções para conflitos ou problemas relacionados à área.

Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Transportes, Gestão Ambiental, ou áreas correlatas;

Supervisão de manutenção de rodovias ou gestão de faixas de domínio, preferencialmente em empresas de concessão de rodovias ou no setor público;

Conhecimento em técnicas de preservação ambiental e gestão de áreas verdes;

Experiência em planejamento e execução de ações de segurança viária e prevenção de acidentes relacionados à faixa de domínio.

Sua missão é transformar a estratégia de Pessoas em ciclos consistentes de gestão de desempenho, desenvolvimento e engajamento, garantindo clareza, direcionamento e sustentação da nossa Cultura Organizacional em todas as operações.

  • Atuar como referência técnica em Cultura Organizacional, assegurando que programas de DHO estejam conectados à narrativa, aos valores e à experiência do colaborador no Grupo FIT.
  • Liderar as frentes de Clima e Engajamento, coordenando pesquisas, leitura estratégica de resultados, devolutivas estruturadas e acompanhamento de planos de ação junto às lideranças e BPs.

  • Indicadores, Análises e Governança de DHO
  • Implementar e monitorar dashboards de DHO, Clima, Engajamento e Cultura, traduzindo dados em análises estratégicas, recomendações e planos de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional que se identifique com nosso propósito e tenha as seguintes qualificações:

  • Organizacionais: Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Visão sistêmica de Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional, capacidade de estruturar e conduzir Ciclos de Gestão de Desempenho (metas, competências, avaliação, PDI e sucessão), leitura e análise de indicadores de Clima, Engajamento e Performance, experiência na construção e acompanhamento de dashboards executivos, condução de fóruns de talentos e reuniões de calibração, estruturação de programas de Desenvolvimento de Lideranças e Educação Corporativa, planejamento e gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos, domínio de Pacote Office e Google Workspace.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Comunicação clara e didática com diferentes níveis de liderança, postura consultiva e influência positiva junto a gestores e BPs, senso de dono sobre indicadores e resultados de performance e clima, organização e priorização estratégica de demandas, escuta ativa e empatia na condução de feedbacks e devolutivas, protagonismo na resolução de problemas, autonomia com responsabilidade, coerência e exemplo vivo da Cultura FIT.
  • Conhecimentos: Vivência sólida em DHO com atuação prática em Gestão de Desempenho, Cultura Organizacional, Clima e Engajamento (mínimo de 4 anos), experiência na implementação e sustentação de ciclos estruturados de avaliação e desenvolvimento, conhecimento em metodologias de desenvolvimento de lideranças e educação corporativa, Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia Empresarial ou áreas correlatas, conhecimentos, Domínio avançado na construção de apresentações executivas (PowerPoint ou similares), com capacidade de estruturar narrativas claras, estratégicas e visualmente organizadas.
  • Diferenciais: Pós-graduação em DHO ou Gestão de Pessoas, experiência com sistemas de performance ou plataformas de T&D (LMS), atuação em empresas com múltiplas unidades operacionais (varejo, food service ou operações de grande volume), experiência em processos estruturados de sucessão e fóruns de talentos.

title: São Paulo - In-Office
description:
We’re looking for a talented and passionate Game Designer & Game Lead to join Wildlife’s New Games team . Wildlife is constantly building and releasing new titles with the goal of bringing fun to billions of people around the world. The company has already surpassed the mark of 4 billion downloads. The New Games Product team is accountable for defining which new games will be produced and building these products in partnership with engineers and artists. These are the products that will drive the company’s growth for the following years.

As a Wildlife Game Designer & Game Lead , you will define new game theses to be validated by the executives team, you will also be accountable for the game’s vision throughout the development cycle, from prototyping to global launch. You will use player feedback, data analysis and accurate business sense to improve the game’s performance.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company’s success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you’ll do
  • Using market research, propose new game theses that can be played by millions of people for multiple years
  • Define the new game’s vision and product roadmap (adapting it if needed as we gather more data about the product)
  • Design the game’s main features and write their specifications
  • In partnership with the game’s art leader and the distribution team define the game theme and art style
  • Review game design decisions made by the rest of the team (artists and engineers)
  • Coordinate deliveries within the core team and with related disciplines (engineering, art, distribution, data science)
  • Provide product and game design leadership through your own experience, competitor analyses, playtests, player feedback, data analysis, etc.) within the product’s core team
  • Analyze the performance of new versions and features released. Continuously refine the roadmap based on new findings
What you’ll need
  • Experience in product or game design roles within game development (shipping games on any platform, leading product development in game jams or hackathons)
  • Passionate about games, you have been a player your whole life
  • Flexibility to work in iterative development cycles with frequent releases
  • Strong interpersonal skills
Nice to Have
  • Experience shipping mobile games
  • Programming skills that allow you to develop prototypes independently
  • Experience using AI tools for art creation or programming
More about you
  • Excited about joining the most valuable, highest growth start-up in Brazil that will provide you meaningful work, meaningful relationships, continuous meaningful learning, and a team radically committed to produce great products
  • Thoughtful and analytical decision-maker: you consider multiple solutions to the same problem and can see nuance where others don’t to decide what level of detail/sophistication you’ll need to make an informed timely decision
  • A structured and creative thinker: with a structured mindset you are able to harness chaos into a logical architecture, where others would give-up you won’t, and by digging into benchmarks you’re able to uncover unthinkable solutions to your day‑by‑day problems
  • A natural but humble leader and mentor: as an accomplished leader, you’re able to speak on a broad spectrum of topics; your demeanor diffuses conflicts and puts people at ease, helping you give constructive feedback and build relationships across cultures and interacting and coordinating the work of several teams, to extract the most value from each team member
  • A multicultural gamer: you love gaming (console, mobile, board, or card games) as much as we do, so you’ll plug that passion into providing players’ needs with unparalleled focus
About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Finland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

title: Software Engineering Director
description:
This is the general track for Engineering Director at Canonical, apply here if you are confident to run a project which spans teams and time zones, hiring and managing engineering managers and staff engineers. Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working together under a single director of engineering. Once you have passed the first round of interviews we will discuss specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests. We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of "most software to most companies". To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors set the pace and direction to help teams achieve more than they realized they could, and feel proud of the result. Even though this is a senior management position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding developers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You need to understand what great code looks like in the language and genre of your product – whether that is a web service, a system daemon, a desktop application, or a distributed system. You'll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve clarity around quality and performance. You'll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus, and learning.

We have director level roles across a wide range of engineering domains, including:

  • Python and Golang
  • C / C++ / Rust
  • Data infrastructure
  • HTML / CSS / JavaScript / Typescript / React
  • Flutter
  • Distro packaging and systems
  • SAAS and web microservices
  • Kernel
  • Servers
  • Graphics, Browser and Desktop
  • Silicon enablement and embedded devices
  • Product Security

If your domain of expertise isn't listed above, yet you feel it's relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.

Location: The role is remote, with positions available in all time zones. It includes a requirement for global travel twice per year, for trips up to two weeks long.

What you'll do
  • Lead multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Develop your engineering managers and maintain Canonical culture
  • Hire staff level engineers for specific roles like performance and quality
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure indicators of team health and productivity
  • Ensure rounded delivery including community participation and docs
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes and defend them
  • Set and measure progress against benchmark goals for speed and efficiency
  • Represent your product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
  • Collaborate with leads for related or dependent products
What we're looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Extensive management experience and confidence to set high expectations
  • Outstanding Linux based software engineering track record
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Public speaking and presentation skills
  • A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring software developers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • Well‑organised, self‑starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • You have advanced expertise in your own domain
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • Open source community engagement and leadership
  • Ops and system administration experience
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Partnerships Manager - São Paulo
description:
At MWS, we are on a mission to become the home of game-worn culture. We do this by connecting global fanbases to the ultimate fan item: game-used and signed shirts from the world's biggest athletes and brands around the world. We accelerate engagement, interaction, and revenue by enabling our customers to access pieces of sporting history, while raising funds for the causes that matter most to our partners. We do it all live from kick-off. With more than 350 partners globally, we are the outright market leaders in our industry. We see ourselves as innovators, constantly looking for new ways to surprise and delight our audience.

About the role

As the Partnerships Manager in Brazil, you will oversee the lifecycle of our Brazilian partner network, from nurturing established relationships to scouting and onboarding new strategic partners. This role is central to maintaining a profitable, trust-driven portfolio that supports our continued expansion within the region. You will be the face of MWS in Brazil, ensuring best-in-class service while maximizing financial performance for our partner charities.

Responsibilities
  • Managing a portfolio of partners in the Brazil region to ensure high-quality service and long-term satisfaction.
  • Identifying and executing opportunities within partnerships to maximize revenue for partner charities and foundations.
  • Supporting the Business Development team in formulating commercial deals to expand the business across the region.
  • Developing a deep understanding of rights holders, clubs, and individuals to build trust and strengthen personal relationships.
  • Effectively articulating thoughts, initiatives, and feedback to internal and external stakeholders at every level of the hierarchy.
  • Working with multiple departments to learn the full-service MWS solution and facilitate sustainable partnerships.
About the team

You will be part of our small team in São Paulo where you will work with 2 driven colleagues in Business Development and Operations, who ensure new partners are added to our portfolio and the shirts are being meticulously processed and delivered to fans and collectors worldwide. Overseas you will find your 15 colleagues in Partnerships, who each manage a portfolio of partners in their region across the many sports we offer on our platform. You will have daily contact with them to ensure providing the highest quality service to our partners.

Skills & Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in a sports commercial role or sports/entertainment partnerships.
  • A university degree in a relevant field.
  • Strong understanding of market trends and the ability to drive success for partners through financial growth.
  • Team player with ability to manage internal and external relationships at every level of the partnership hierarchy.
  • Proven track record in the partnerships space with direct experience in activating from either/all of a rights holder, brand or agency.
  • Ability to think of solutions and provide reassurance to partners in a dynamic, "hectic" sports environment.
  • Natural negotiation skills and willingness to take on more challenging conversations with partner counterparts at every level.
  • High-level verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to manage diverse cultures.
  • Highly motivated individual with a "can-do" attitude, capable of working efficiently under strict deadlines.
  • A Brazilian passport or valid working rights for Brazil.
What We Offer
  • Informal and Sporty Environment: An informal, international, and sports-focused work environment.
  • Room for Initiative and Impact: Plenty of room for your ideas and the opportunity to make a real impact.
  • Hospitality seats: Enjoy a great match at one of our business seats at clubs all over the world.
  • Health insurance reimbursement: We cover the expense of a healthcare plan, because health comes first!.
  • All equipment you need: We provide you with a MacBook, mouse and keyboard of choice. Need anything else? Let\'s talk!.
  • Company events: Multiple times per year we organise formal and not so formal events in our office and elsewhere.
  • Location: This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil, with regular travel to visit partners across the region.
Our procedure
  1. Introductory video call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (± 20 min).
  2. Assessment round (± 120 min).
  3. Online interview round 1 (± 45-60 min).
  4. An informal coffee and visit to your new office (± 45 min).
  5. In-office interview round 2 (± 45-60 min).
  6. Before the in-office interviews we request every candidate to complete a personality questionnaire, which gives us insight as to how your personality could add value to the team.
  7. If all goes well we will provide you with an offer letter and we can welcome you to the team!

Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end‑to‑end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in‑house technology to provide our clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. We provide customers across industries and geographies with a tailored portfolio of solutions to address their business needs. Within Data and Services, the Business & Market Intelligence (B&MI) suite of products aims to bring to market innovative solutions combining the power of consulting and technology. With compelling offerings for financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies and more, our services drive efficiency and value and enable our customers to solve business problems from end to end. The role will lead initiatives to support the growth and scalability of the B&MI product suite business in the region.

All About the Role

As an Associate Managing Consultant, Customer Success Product Specialist, you will develop deep expertise in Mastercard products and solutions and be accountable for driving customer value, adoption, and retention. You will lead customer engagements, oversee delivery of complex solutions, and function as the voice of the customer to continuously improve the customer experience and product roadmap. This is a client‑facing, execution‑oriented role requiring strong consulting, delivery, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a commercial and data‑driven mindset.

Your Responsibilities Customer Engagement & Value Delivery
  • Build and manage strong, trusted relationships with mid and executive‑level customer stakeholders.
  • Function as a coach and trusted advisor, guiding customers on how to implement and optimize Mastercard products to achieve measurable business outcomes.
  • Study the viability of proposed solutions and identify optimization opportunities aligned to customer strategic goals.
  • Manage user onboarding and proactively strengthen customer capabilities, skills, and product knowledge.
  • Conduct platform demonstrations, training sessions, and customer webinars.
Product Expertise & Delivery
  • Lead assigned delivery projects to ensure contractual objectives, timelines, and quality standards are met.
  • Serve as the subject‑matter expert on products and solutions, advising on best‑practice implementation.
  • Research and deliver solutions to complex customer problems and respond to customer inquiries.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, customer‑centric solutions.
  • Function as liaison between customers and product teams, supporting prioritization of enhancements, customizations, and client‑specific features.
Data‑Driven Customer Success
  • Monitor customer health, product adoption, and engagement metrics to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Identify customers at risk of churn and proactively implement mitigation plans.
  • Articulate and track key performance indicators related to cost, performance, optimization, and value realization.
  • Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points to refine value propositions and improve products.
Commercial Growth & Retention
  • Demonstrate a commercial mindset by identifying cross‑sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities.
  • Drive licence retention and support new logo acquisition in partnership with sales teams.
  • Leverage Mastercard’s broader offerings to maximize customer value and long‑term partnership potential.
  • Evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements to ensure solutions are financially viable and data‑backed.
Operational Excellence & Enablement
  • Identify and realise operational efficiencies in how solutions are delivered to customers.
  • Develop scalable training materials, thought leadership, and customer‑facing playbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across product, sales, technology, and delivery teams.
All About You
  • Proven experience delivering SaaS solutions, data products, or analytics platforms.
  • Background in customer delivery, customer success, or consulting with a strong record of driving customer value.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem‑solving skills with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making.
  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire others and foster a collaborative, high‑performance culture.
  • Experience building and maintaining executive‑level client relationships.
All About Your Education & Skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.
  • Fluent local office language and English required, other languages desirable.
  • Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills required.
  • Comfortable with significant customer interaction and executive‑level engagement.
  • Leveraging market analysis, customer insights, and performance data to drive strategy and innovation.
  • Data analytics and business intelligence tools and methodologies.
  • Translating complex technical capabilities into customer‑focused solutions.
  • Analysing customer metrics to drive retention, adoption, and mutual profitability.
  • Identifying “next best opportunities” to expand and deepen customer partnerships.
  • Creative problem‑solving and development of innovative solutions.
  • Experience with technology, financial services, acquirers/processors, service providers, or digital platform partners.
Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Introdução

Estamos buscando por Técnico(a) Laboratório Pl para se juntar à nossa equipe de Processos de Laboratório.Você será responsável por executar atividades de caráter técnico, como ensaios, visando métodos adequados para o processo de análises, cumprir prazos previamente acordados ao trabalho, identificar e propor soluções a problemas oriundos de processos e análises.Você desempenhará um papel crucial para o sucesso do nosso negócio.

Nesta posição, você se reportará ao Coordenador de Processos.

Esta posição está localizada principalmente em Sorocaba e não envolve viagens.

Equipe a qual você pertence

Você se juntará a uma equipe de Laboratório dedicada a realização de ensaios, análises e métodos.

Atualmente estamos trabalhando na modernização do Laboratório com ampliação do portfólio de análises e com novos equipamentos para dar suporte e atuar como apoio para a fábrica.

Trabalhamos em estreita colaboração no dia a dia com partes interessadas internas/externas, como Industrial, Qualidade, Engenharia e Suprimentos.

A cultura da nossa equipe gira em torno de cliente no centro, grande ambição - sempre, fazendo o que deve ser feito – juntos e abertos e sinceros.

Os membros da nossa equipe estão localizados em Sorocaba.

O que você fará

  • Executar ensaios diversos de metal (análises químicas por espectrometria, FRX, combustão; ensaios mecânicos como impacto, dureza e microdureza; metalografias por microscopia de bancada e campo, réplica; radioatividade);
  • Executar ensaios diversos de areia (finos, resistência, carbono, etc);
  • Executar ensaios diversos de óleo (quenchímetro, Karl Fischer, viscosidade, crepitação, etc);
  • Executar ensaios diversos que possam ser atribuídos ao Laboratório;
  • Executar atividades de preparação de amostras (cortes, quebras, lixamento, polimento, etc);
  • Participar e contribuir em reuniões de segurança, meio ambiente e ergonomia;
  • Desenvolvimento de fornecedores e clientes para novos processos, produtos e mercados com foco nas análises laboratoriais;
  • Elaboração e revisão dos procedimentos operacionais da área de Laboratório;
  • Aplicação de procedimentos técnicos nas áreas da Fundição, como Aciaria, Tratamento Térmico, Metalografia, Moldagem e Solda;
  • Realização da análise de falhas e emissão de relatórios.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos em geral.

Experiência em ensaios gerais de metalurgia, metalografia e análise de óleos;

Técnico Completo em Metalurgia, Química ou Materiais;

Disponibilidade de horários;

Residir em Sorocaba ou Votorantim;

Inglês intermediário será um diferencial;

Desejável experiência com Power BI.

O que oferecemos

· Um propósito inspirador – Possibilitar uma vida moderna sustentável. Minerais e metais são a espinha dorsal de funções essenciais no mundo moderno. No entanto, há uma necessidade de soluções mais sustentáveis para os coletar e processar. Na Metso, você participa da transformação da indústria e de uma mudança positiva.

· Ambiente de trabalho seguro – Para a Metso, segurança é um valor fundamental. Nosso objetivo é demonstrar liderança e visão na promoção da cultura de segurança.

· Bem-estar – Nossos serviços de saúde ocupacional, associados às ações voltadas para a promoção de saúde e bem-estar demonstram nossa preocupação com a qualidade de vida e engajamento das pessoas.

· Remuneração e benefícios – Estrutura de remuneração e benefícios alinhada às práticas de mercado, oferecendo um pacote atrativo através de uma composição equilibrada que contém remuneração fixa e variável, além de assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida, previdência privada, alimentação, entre outros, segundo políticas vigentes.

· Flexibilidade – Defendemos as interações pessoais e a colaboração presencial associadas a um ambiente de trabalho aberto e flexível, valorizando o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

· Uma cultura próspera - Estamos empenhados em desenvolver uma cultura inclusiva que permita a todos dar o seu melhor e atingir o seu pleno potencial. Uma cultura que é corajosa, convincente e atenciosa, e que nos une para construirmos juntos um futuro sustentável.

· Extensas oportunidades de aprendizagem – Estimulamos diálogos contínuos, sessões de feedback, oportunidades de mobilidade interna, programas de mentoria, treinamento e desenvolvimento, entre outros projetos ambiciosos e oportunidades globais.

· Interação sem fronteiras – Aproveite nossa rede de colegas em todo o mundo para troca de experiências e conhecimento. Realizamos os trabalhos juntos, através de uma comunicação aberta e sincera.

title: Coordenador Comercial
description:
A JusCash é uma startup que atua na análise, precificação e antecipação de créditos judiciais para advogados. Estamos transformando o mercado jurídico com tecnologia e inteligência.

Saiba mais em:

Somos feitos de gente inquieta, empreendedora e que valoriza o trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável nasce de pessoas que amam o que fazem, com autonomia, responsabilidade e brilho no olho. Se você se identifica com esse espírito e quer construir algo grande junto com a gente, essa vaga pode ser sua!

Coordenador Comercial você irá exercer um papel muito importante no crescimento da JusCash e de nossos produtos.

Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um líder comercial com perfil de pessoas, empreendedor e data-driven para tracionar nossa operação de vendas Inbound. Você será responsável por transformar nossa atual força de vendas em uma "máquina de alta produtividade", eliminando gargalos operacionais através de tecnologia, otimizando a jornada do cliente e preparando nossos talentos internos para futuras posições de destaque.

Atribuições e Responsabilidades
  • Gestão e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: Liderar o time de vendas (10 pessoas), conduzindo ritos de gestão (1:1s, feedbacks frequentes e roleplays). Identificar e mentorar potenciais talentos para assumirem cargos de maior relevância em curto prazo.
  • Otimização de Processos (Sales Ops): Mapear a jornada do cliente e redesenhar o funil de vendas para eliminar tarefas manuais. Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de automação (CRM, discadores, sequências de mensagens).
  • Cultura de Dados (Data Driven): Monitorar KPIs em tempo real (Taxa de Conversão, CAC, Ciclo de Vendas, Produtividade por Headcount). Gerar relatórios e dashboards para munir a diretoria com insights estratégicos.
  • Estratégia de Expansão: Desenvolver e testar novos canais de aquisição e abordagens de vendas para além do Inbound atual.
  • Alinhamento Interfuncional: Colaborar com as áreas de Marketing (ajuste de qualidade de leads) e Produto/Customer Success (alinhamento de expectativas e redução de churn).
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Perfil Tech-Savvy: Domínio avançado de CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce ou similares) e ferramentas de produtividade. Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de vendas e integração de dados.
  • Liderança Inspiradora: Habilidade comprovada em desenvolver pessoas e manter o clima organizacional em ambientes de alta pressão e volume.
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Capacidade de transformar números em planos de ação. Familiaridade com as métricas de crescimento de Fintechs/SaaS.
  • Visão de Processos: Visão sistêmica para entender que "vendas é processo, não apenas talento".
  • Formação: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou cursos específicos em Gestão de Vendas/Growth são diferenciais.
Experiência Prévia Necessária
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em áreas comerciais, com pelo menos 2 anos em cargos de liderança.
  • Experiência sólida em operações de Inside Sales (vendas internas/online) de alto volume.
  • Desejável passagem por Startups ou Fintechs em fase de tração ou escala (Scale-up).
  • Histórico comprovado de ter liderado projetos de implementação de tecnologias ou mudança de processos que resultaram em ganho de produtividade/escala.

Sobre a Newell Brands

Na Newell Brands, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa líder global em bens de consumo, com mais de 50 marcas icônicas que podem ser encontradas em lares ao redor do mundo, incluindo Oster®, Cadence®, NUK®, Lillo®, Invicta®, Contigo®, Coleman®, Rubbermaid®, PaperMate®, Sharpie®, Graco® entre outras.

Você fará parte de uma cultura colaborativa, solidária e respeitosa, onde valorizamos a diversidade e a singularidade de cada pessoa, reconhecendo que diferentes visões ampliam nossa capacidade de inovar e gerar impacto. Descrição da função

Como Supervisor de Logística , você será responsável por liderar e garantir a eficiência das operações de recebimento, armazenagem, picking, logística reversa e expedição, assegurando o cumprimento dos SLAs e a acuracidade dos estoques. Atuará na gestão da equipe, promovendo segurança, melhoria contínua, controle orçamentário e excelência operacional para atender às demandas do negócio com qualidade e agilidade.

Responsabilidades
  • Garantir a eficiência e precisão dos processos de recebimento, armazenagem, picking, logística reversa e expedição, assegurando o atendimento ágil e correto das demandas
  • Gerenciar a operação logística e a equipe, organizando, delegando atividades, treinando, orientando e fornecendo feedback, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, rotinas e políticas internas
  • Acompanhar a carteira de pedidos dos canais online e de varejo, assegurando o cumprimento dos SLAs e propondo alternativas para melhor utilização dos recursos disponíveis
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo do pedido: processamento, separação, embalagem, geração de documentação, armazenagem temporária, preparação e expedição
  • Assegurar a correta utilização de equipamentos e infraestrutura, garantindo que apenas colaboradores habilitados operem máquinas e equipamentos restritos, promovendo um ambiente seguro e alinhado à meta de Acidentes Zero
  • Garantir a acuracidade das informações nos sistemas e planilhas de controle, realizando auditorias periódicas e mantendo histórico para atender auditorias internas e externas
  • Assegurar a acuracidade dos estoques (produtos acabados, materiais de uso e consumo, partes e peças), organizando e liderando inventários e equipes de contagem
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, visando aumento de produtividade, redução de custos, otimização de processos e melhoria da experiência do cliente
  • Apoiar a gestão orçamentária da área, planejamento de headcount, recrutamento e desenvolvimento da equipe, promovendo a cultura, estratégia, compliance e diversidade
  • Atuar em parceria com fornecedores e clientes, garantindo qualidade, pontualidade e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio
  • Desenvolver estratégias para aprimorar a eficiência operacional em operações de e-commerce, realizando benchmarking, avaliando tecnologias, automação, layout e modelos operacionais para manter a competitividade da operação
Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em sistemas de ERP e WMS
  • Domínio avançado do Microsoft Excel e outras ferramentas de análise de dados
  • Experiência anterior em operações logísticas de alto desempenho, lidando com um grande volume de pedidos
  • Experiência em liderança e treinamento de equipes, garantindo o desenvolvimento contínuo e a excelência operacional
  • Experiência em controle de estoque e condução eficaz de auditorias periódicas para assegurar a acuracidade das informações
